newsitem.title: USA: US FCC chief wants repeal of rule on TV ad sales.
newsitem.headline: US FCC chief wants repeal of rule on TV ad sales.

text.p: The chairman of the Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday he wants his agency to repeal a rule that bars television networks from representing their affiliates in the sale of TV station advertising time.
"The real-world effect of the rule is to protect a small handful of advertising rep firms from competition," FCC Chairman Reed said in a speech to an industry conference.
"Can't TV stations make up their own mind about who should represent them? Does the government need to protect them from their own decisions?"

In criticizing the so-called "station rep rule," Hundt also questioned whether the bargaining relationship between networks and their affiliates "is so out of whack that the government must step in and manage the relationship."
